manual_cases.title: Freshness after edit, deletion and rename
manual_cases.requirement: Change the primary boundary, then rename/delete a referenced file in a disposable copy. An old snapshot must remain explicitly stale; after reindex, old nodes/edges/chunks disappear and replacement spans match current bytes. Never treat an unrefreshed snapshot as live.

manual_cases.title: Same-size edit with preserved mtime
manual_cases.requirement: Replace eight with seven while preserving length and mtime. Document refresh must either detect the edit or explicitly document metadata-only freshness; a hash-verified claim must not remain true.

manual_cases.title: CLI JSON and persistent MCP parity
manual_cases.requirement: Run documents search, mcp search_documents --json, and a persistent MCP search against the same generation. Compare identities/ranks/evidence, and record index writes. Querying must not secretly rebuild one surface while another pins stale data.

manual_cases.title: Automatic workspace routing with independent client roots
manual_cases.requirement: Using PR #34, open primary and peer as separate cwd/root sessions on one generic MCP entry. No manual workspace names. Repeated identical queries must never return the other graph, canary, document or symbol ID. Test both directions and after reopening. The runner only verifies separately built local indexes, not this protocol claim.

manual_cases.title: Precise source-link target range
manual_cases.requirement: Resolve storage.py#L4-L7 to evidence retaining the target line range or exact symbol, not just a file-level association. Invalid/reversed/out-of-bounds fragments must remain unresolved.

manual_cases.title: Counterfactual policy change across languages
manual_cases.requirement: Ask which files need changes to use twelve mebibytes. Find authoritative rationale, server guards, both clients, the stale seven-mebibyte copy, configuration and boundary tests. Treat these as policy associations, not fabricated cross-language calls.

manual_cases.title: Multilingual natural-language recall
manual_cases.requirement: Ask in Hungarian which rule rejects an oversized attachment. Retrieve the authoritative code and policy with valid Unicode spans. Report this challenge separately for an English-only versus multilingual embedding model.

manual_cases.title: Candidate saturation and repeatability
manual_cases.requirement: In a disposable copy, generate more than 10,000 distractor chunks before the relevant document and vary insertion order. The relevant item must remain discoverable or candidate truncation must be surfaced. Measure fixed cold/warm repetitions and ranking variance; do not infer a speedup from a small corpus.

manual_cases.title: Root traversal, symlinks and ignored-path changes
manual_cases.requirement: Add a local link and a symlink to the peer/outside root. Neither document nor knowledge retrieval may read through that boundary. Then exclude a previously indexed file and verify its old content disappears after refresh.

manual_cases.title: Invalid parameters and unavailable embeddings are not empty retrieval
manual_cases.requirement: Submit malformed filters, invalid limits and a deliberately unavailable local model, followed by a valid lexical request. Preserve explicit errors and reader usability. An error or unrun embedding profile must never score as not_found or pass.
